parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const CFG=$json.cfg; const now=DateTime.now().setZone(CFG.timezone); const items=[]; for (const p of CFG.people) for (const c of p.calendars) items.push({id:c}); for (const c of CFG.blockingCalendars) items.push({id:c}); return JSON.stringify({ timeMin: now.toUTC().toISO(), timeMax: now.plus({days:CFG.horizonDays}).toUTC().toISO(), timeZone: CFG.timezone, items }); })() }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ summary: `Vektrum × ${$json.name}`, description: $json.note || '', start: { dateTime: $json.startUTC, timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon' }, end: { dateTime: $json.endUTC, timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon' }, attendees: [ ...($json.members || []).map(email => ({ email })), { email: $json.email } ], conferenceData: { createRequest: { requestId: $json.startUTC + '-' + $json.email, conferenceSolutionKey: { type: 'hangoutsMeet' } } } }) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Re-check slot').first().json.lang === 'en' ? 'Your Vektrum meeting is confirmed' : 'A sua reunião com a Vektrum está confirmada' }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const v = $('Re-check slot').first().json; const meet = $json.hangoutLink || ($json.conferenceData && $json.conferenceData.entryPoints && $json.conferenceData.entryPoints[0] && $json.conferenceData.entryPoints[0].uri) || ''; const isEn = v.lang === 'en'; return isEn ? `

Hi ${v.name},

Your meeting with Vektrum is confirmed.

Google Meet: ${meet}

` : `

Olá ${v.name},

A sua reunião com a Vektrum está confirmada.

Google Meet: ${meet}

`; })() }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: "confirmed", startUTC: $('Re-check slot').first().json.startUTC, endUTC: $('Re-check slot').first().json.endUTC, meetLink: $('Send confirmation email').first().json.hangoutLink || '' } }}
